threepl.simulator

Class SimExpr

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimExpr
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SimExprConstants, SimExprTreeConstants

    public class SimExpr
extends java.lang.Object
implements SimExprTreeConstants, SimExprConstants
    SimExpr contains the parser for the command interface to the simulator. It contains methods to compile a command expression into a node tree, optimise the tree, and evaluate the tree.
    Version:
    $Revision: 868 $
    Author:
    Andrew Tulloh CAUTION: Do not edit SimExpr.jj or SimExpr.java; these files are generated automatically. Make changes to SimExpr.jjt only.
